metrics.name: Model
metrics.gotcha: SystemInfo.Model does NOT exist in the Cisco IOS dataprint — returns null. The correct path for device model/platform is SystemInfo.Platform (e.g., 'C2960X'). Prior path was wrong.

metrics.name: Days Until License Expiration
metrics.gotcha: Recipe verification logs may reference LicenseStatus.expirationInDays — this path does NOT exist. The correct field is LicensingOverview.DaysTillExpiration, confirmed by Global metric id=10.

metrics.name: Device Firmware Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Networks[].Devices[].join(', ', [join(': ', [`Device Name`, to_string(DeviceName)]), join(': ', [`Firmware`, to_string(firmware)])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: Hardware Device List
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Networks[].Devices[?networkId].{Model: model, DeviceName: DeviceName, NetworkName: NetworkName}
metrics.gotcha: The top-level key for Meraki devices is Networks[].Devices[] — NOT NetworkDevices (which does not exist). Always traverse via Networks[]. Confirmed by Global metric id=104678 and recipe verification on System B (2026-05-22).

metrics.name: Open (No Auth) SSID Count
metrics.gotcha: SSIDs are nested under Networks[].SSIDs — not top-level Ssids[]. The recipe pattern Ssids[?authMode == 'open'] will return null. Always traverse via Networks[?Type=='wireless'].SSIDs[].

metrics.name: Privileged User Count
metrics.gotcha: Privileged is the string 'Yes' not boolean true. Filter: Privileged == `Yes` (backtick-quoted string in JMESPath).

metrics.name: Firmware Version
metrics.gotcha: Firmware is at SWVersion not FirmwareVersion (which does not exist). SystemInfo fields: HWVersion, SWVersion (e.g. '1.4.11.5'), FansStatus, SystemName, BootVersion, SystemUpTime (string), SystemContact, SystemLocation, SystemObjectId, SystemMacAddress, SystemDescription.

metrics.name: Total Port Count
metrics.gotcha: The array is InterfacesConfiguration[], NOT a 'Ports' top-level key (which does not exist). Fields include: Neg, Mode, Port (identifier string), Type, Speed, State (string: 'Up'), Duplex, control, Pressure.

metrics.name: Ports Up Count
metrics.gotcha: InterfacesConfiguration[].State is STRING in Title Case: 'Up' (not 'UP' or 'up'). Filter must match case exactly. On demo all 28 ports showed State='Up'.

metrics.name: Serial Number
metrics.gotcha: Serial number is at SystemID.SerialNumber (its own top-level object), NOT SystemInfo.SerialNumber which does not exist. SystemID contains only SerialNumber.

metrics.name: Total VLAN Count
metrics.gotcha: Top-level key is VLAN (singular), NOT VLANs (plural). VLAN[] fields include: Name (string), Vlan (integer VLAN ID), CreatedBy, TaggedPorts (array of port IDs), UntaggedPorts (array of port IDs).

metrics.name: Access List Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: AccessLists[].entries[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`ACL Name`, to_string(ACL_Name_r)]), join(`: `, [`ACL Type`, to_string(ACL_Type_r)]), join(`: `, [`Applied`, to_string(ACL_Applied_r)]), join(`: `, [`Protocol`, to_string(Proto)]), join(`: `, [`Sequence`, to_string(SEQ)]) , join(`: `, [`Source IP`, to_string(SrcIP)]), join(`: `, [`Destination IP`, to_string(DstIP)]) , join(`: `, [`Action`, to_string(Action)]), join(`: `, [`IP`, to_string(IP)])])

metrics.name: IGMP Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: IGMP[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`ID`, to_string(ID)]), join(`: `, [`Name`, to_string(Name)]), join(`: `, [`Enabled`, to_string(IGMPenabled)]), join(`: `, [`Querier Allowed`, to_string(QuerierAllowed)]), join(`: `, [`Querier Interval`, to_string(QuerierInterval)])])

metrics.name: Interface Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Interfaces[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Port`, to_string(Port)]), join(`: `, [`Name`, to_string(Name)]), join(`: `, [`Type`, to_string(Type)]), join(`: `, [`Speed`, to_string(Speed)]), join(`: `, [`Enabled`, to_string(Enabled)]), join(`: `, [`Tagged`, to_string(Tagged)]) , join(`: `, [`Status`, to_string(Status)])])

metrics.name: IP Configuration Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: IPConfiguration[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Vlan`, to_string(VLAN)]), join(`: `, [`IP Config`, to_string(IPConfig)]), join(`: `, [`Proxy Arp`, to_string(ProxyARP)]), join(`: `, [`IP`, to_string(IPAddress)]), join(`: `, [`Subnet Mask`, to_string(SubnetMask)])])

metrics.name: LACP Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: LACP[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`LACP Status`, to_string(LACPStatus)]), join(`: `, [`Port`, to_string(Port)]), join(`: `, [`Trunk Group`, to_string(TrunkGroup)]), join(`: `, [`LACPEnabled`, to_string(LACPEnabled)])])

metrics.name: Ports with Security Violation Detected Count
Trunk Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Trunks[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Name`, to_string(Name)]), join(`: `, [`Port`, to_string(Port)]), join(`: `, [`Type`, to_string(Trunk)]), join(`: `, [`Group`, to_string(Group)]), join(`: `, [`Interface Type`, to_string(InterfaceType)])])

metrics.name: VLAN Priority Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: QoS.VLANPriority[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Vlan ID`, to_string(VLAN_ID)]), join(`: `, [`Priority`, to_string(Priority)]), join(`: `, [`Apply Rule`, to_string(ApplyRule)])])

metrics.name: VLAN Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: VLANs[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`ID`, to_string(ID)]), join(`: `, [`Name`, to_string(Name)]), join(`: `, [`Jumbo`, to_string(Jumbo)]), join(`: `, [`Voice`, to_string(Voice)]), join(`: `, [`Status`, to_string(Status)])])
